meta._wpe_seo_description: Guides, release notes and new demos from the WPEssential team.

content.title: Import a demo in one click
content.excerpt: Pick a demo, choose Gutenberg or Elementor and import pages, menus and products in about two minutes.
content.content:
<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cp\u003eEvery demo ships a Gutenberg and an Elementor version. The importer installs the plugins the demo needs, brings in pages, products, menus and images, and logs each step so you can resume if anything stops.\u003c/p\u003e"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/heading {"text":"1. Open the Demo Library","tag":"h2"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cp\u003eGo to WPEssential → Demo Library in wp-admin and pick a demo.\u003c/p\u003e"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/image {"image":{"id":{{media_id:shot-library}},"url":"{{media:shot-library}}"},"alt":"The Demo Library in the WPEssential dashboard","size":"full"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/heading {"text":"2. Choose your builder","tag":"h2"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cp\u003eSelect Gutenberg or Elementor. Both versions look the same.\u003c/p\u003e"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/heading {"text":"3. Install required plugins","tag":"h2"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cp\u003eThe wizard lists the plugins and installs them for you.\u003c/p\u003e"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/image {"image":{"id":{{media_id:shot-plugins}},"url":"{{media:shot-plugins}}"},"alt":"The plugins step of the import wizard","size":"full"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/heading {"text":"4. Import","tag":"h2"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cp\u003eKeep the tab open. A typical demo imports in under two minutes.\u003c/p\u003e"} /-->

content.title: Gutenberg or Elementor: which package?
content.excerpt: Both versions look the same. Here is how to choose the right one for your site.
content.content:
<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cp\u003eEach demo is built twice, natively: once with core blocks and once with Elementor widgets. Neither is a converted copy of the other.\u003c/p\u003e"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eChoose Gutenberg for the fastest pages and no page-builder plugin.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eChoose Elementor if your team already edits with it.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eSwitching later means importing the other package on a fresh site.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/image {"image":{"id":{{media_id:site-maison}},"url":"{{media:site-maison}}"},"alt":"The Maison demo home page","size":"full"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cp\u003ePick Gutenberg for the leanest pages; pick Elementor when your team already edits with it. The design is the same either way.\u003c/p\u003e\u003ccite\u003eWPEssential team\u003c/cite\u003e","tag":"blockquote"} /-->

content.title: Hi WPEssential 1.0.0 is out
content.excerpt: Pulse and Maison demos, AI Connect and shop filters — everything in the first stable release.
content.content: <!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cp\u003eVersion 1.0.0 brings the Pulse and Maison demos for Gutenberg and Elementor, AI Connect (MCP), shop filters with variation swatches, and dark mode colours on every style variation.\u003c/p\u003e"} /-->

content.title: New demo: Pulse for conferences and events
content.excerpt: Speakers, a two-day agenda, ticket passes and The Events Calendar, ready to import.
content.content:
<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cp\u003ePulse is our second Pro demo. It is built for conferences, meetups and anyone who sells tickets.\u003c/p\u003e"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eSpeaker grid and profiles\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTwo-day agenda with tracks and rooms\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTicket passes sold through WooCommerce\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eEvents calendar with venues and organisers\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/image {"image":{"id":{{media_id:mobile-pulse}},"url":"{{media:mobile-pulse}}"},"alt":"Pulse on a phone","size":"full"} /-->

<!-- wp:wpessential/text {"content":"\u003cp\u003ePulse is included in the Pro and Agency plans, or you can buy it on its own.\u003c/p\u003e"} /-->

content.title: Ayesha Malik
content.content: We rebuilt three client sites in a week. The Gutenberg and Elementor versions match pixel for pixel, so the team just picks one.

content.title: Daniel Brooks
content.content: The import just works. Pages, products, menus and the dark mode were all there after one click, and the support team answered within hours.

content.title: Sara Ahmed
content.content: We imported Maison on Monday and launched the client store on Wednesday. Our team now starts every shop from a WPEssential demo.

options.blogdescription: Premium WordPress themes and one-click demos.
wpessential_testimonials: We rebuilt three client sites in a week. The Gutenberg and Elementor versions match pixel for pixel, so the team just picks one.
The import just works. Pages, products, menus and the dark mode were all there after one click, and the support team answered within hours.
We imported Maison on Monday and launched the client store on Wednesday. Our team now starts every shop from a WPEssential demo.
options.wpessential_blog_lead: Tutorials for the theme, new demos and WordPress tips from the WPEssential team.
options.wpessential_404_title: This page took a different demo.
options.wpessential_404_lead: The link may be old or mistyped. Search the site or start from one of these.
